diagnosis: The HTMX fragment endpoint renders sensitive organization membership and role permissions by member_id without verifying that member.org_id == current_user.org_id. An attacker can craft HTMX requests to render permission fragments containing private email addresses, assigned security roles, and activity status of members from other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /hx/v1/members/8819/permission-card HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.com
HX-Request: true
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
